summary: All acceptance criteria verified: --help now prints usage and exits 0, unknown options still fail properly, and all test suites pass.
overseer_note: Independently ran all required commands on commit a49d227db1d6ec656b25416458b79845c6cba64c. Verified: (1) git diff --stat shows changes only in scope (src/cli.js, tests/unit/cli.test.js, 69 additions), (2) npm test: 364 passed, 0 failed, (3) npm run validate:examples: 7/7 documents valid, (4) node src/cli.js policy check: ok, (5) git diff --check: no whitespace issues, (6) node src/cli.js gate check --help: prints full usage and exits 0, (7) node src/cli.js validate --nope: correctly errors with exit 1. Implementation adds hasHelpFlag() function that intercepts --help/-h at the top of main(), scanning VALUE_OPTIONS to skip option arguments properly. Tests comprehensively cover all 16 command/subcommand paths with both --help and -h flags, plus edge cases (option values and arguments after -- are not treated as help requests, unknown options remain errors). All acceptance criteria satisfied.
